notes.title: Dispatch Premieres October 22
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re thrilled to announce that [b][i]Dispatch[/i][/b] launches on [b]October 22, 2025![/b] [/h3][p]Watch our release date trailer for a closer look at what’s in store:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="PzRQrDK7zUs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]We’re also announcing that [i][b]Dispatch[/b][/i] will be released episodically.[/h3][p][/p][p]On Wednesday October 22nd the first 2 episodes will premiere.  [/p][p]And a week later – on Wednesday October 29th – episodes 3 and 4 will drop, and so on.[/p][p][/p][h3]2 episodes a week, for 4 weeks. [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343539/bf21f89c692d28c5ff5828c9ac0256b531be380f.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve always loved the promise of the episodic model for games – the conversation and speculation it generates, the discrete bite-sized pieces of content that are easier to consume, and if you get to it late, it allows you some time to catch up with everyone and not feel like you’ve been completely left behind. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to finally be able to share that experience with everyone starting on [b]October 22nd[/b]. Until then, jump into [b][url="https://discord.adhocstudio.com"]our Discord[/url][/b], hit that [b]Wishlist[/b] button, and [b]follow[/b] along on socials.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2592160/Dispatch/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks again for your tremendous patience and excitement for our game. [b][i]Dispatch[/i][/b] is our team’s first game, years in the making, and we can’t wait to release it into the world. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343539/e104ba44bce4b227110f6ae3b897b56776d48c78.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: A First Look At Dispatch—Calling All Heroes
notes.notes:
I was actually pretty interested in Dispatch when it was first revealed during The Game Awards 2024. I feel like there’s been a fair bit of time between the exhausting release of episodic games and the genre’s…let’s say hibernation that the prospect of a new one was actually exciting again. Not only that, but rather than being based on an existing property, this game was going to be its own unique story and ideas, which only sweetened the pot.

CGM got a chance to sit down with AdHoc Studio to get a first look at Dispatch, and it made a pretty impressive first impression. Not only does it look to tell a compelling and engaging story, rounded out by a cast of complex and interesting characters, but it’s got a lot more depth to its gameplay than the average point-and-click inspired narrative game.

notes.title: Dispatch Tops The Charts of Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dispatchers![/b] None of us at AdHoc were prepared for this level of love and support. Of course, we [i]hoped[/i] you’d enjoy the little demo we put together for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], but seeing just how many of you played it, loved it, and shared your excitement has been beyond anything we imagined. So from all of us at the studio, [b]thank you.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Our demo for [i][b]Dispatch[/b] [/i]was one of the most played demos at June’s Steam Next Fest. The demo received over[/h3][p][/p][h2][b]300,000 downloads[/b] & [b]2,000 Overwhelmingly Positive reviews[/b].[/h2][p][/p][h3]As a result, [i][b]Dispatch[/b][/i] has surpassed[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343539/29f61f994f62745a73d1f595593ea81e38117183.png"][/img][/p][p][b]To say we’re blown away would be an understatement.[/b][/p][p]
It’s been incredible seeing the response to [i][b]Dispatch[/b][/i]. We know we’re making a weird thing, so watching hundreds of thousands of people check out the demo and actually connect with it has meant a lot to everyone on the team. We’re listening, we’re reading everything, and we’re just really grateful for the support.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re so thankful to everyone who’s played, streamed, reviewed, or even just hit “Wishlist.” This game means a lot to us. And [b]your support makes all the difference.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Dispatch[/b][/i] launches later this year on console and PC via Steam. Until then, jump into [url="https://discord.adhocstudio.com"]our Discord[/url], hit that Wishlist button, and follow along on socials. We’ve got more to share soon—and we can’t wait to take this weird ride with you.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2592160/Dispatch/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Thanks for being a part of this journey![/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dispatch Demo Released!
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to announce the first-ever playable demo of [b][i]Dispatch[/i][/b] during [b]Steam Next Fest![/b] To kick off the release, we've cut together a quick trailer that premiered at the [b]PC Gaming Show[/b] to help spread the word. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="LJt-4YgRAng;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Play the Demo[/h2][p]In this demo, you’ll dive into Robert’s first day as an SDN Dispatcher, meeting new co-workers and encountering the infamous Z-Team—ex-supervillains enrolled in the Phoenix Program, an initiative aimed at rehabilitating them (or at least trying to).[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2592160/Dispatch/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]About [i]Dispatch[/i][/h2][p][i]Dispatch[/i], AdHoc Studio’s debut game, is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter, set against the backdrop of modern-day Los Angeles.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ll step into the shoes of Robert Robertson—better known as Mecha Man—who finds himself without his signature suit after losing a battle with his nemesis. With no choice but to rebuild, Robert takes on a new role at SDN, a hero-for-hire agency, trading combat for a desk job dispatching superheroes.  [/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343539/a5ff5db1a9f1b3838da36ae39ecdbcb3e7bdd233.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343539/811632a71a3dba26c1f37a6ad34cc5ec6ae12c71.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343539/49efd784f16c775cda77146f8abfd1129c1e1c45.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2]About AdHoc Studio[/h2][p]We are a small independent game studio loosely based in Los Angeles, CA, but have people on our team from all over the states, Canada, Brazil, and other parts of the world. Our studio was founded by folks who previously worked at Telltale Games, Ubisoft, and Night School Studio, writing and directing on critically acclaimed titles like [i]The Walking Dead[/i], [i]The Wolf Among Us[/i], and [i]Tales from the Borderlands[/i]. Much like those games, [i]Dispatch[/i] puts interactive narrative at the heart of the experience.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's Next[/h2][p][i]Dispatch[/i] is coming out this year, so the whole team is heads down finishing it! There's only 6 months left inside 2025, so yeah, we're equally freaked out and committed to getting it done on time. [/p][p][/p][p]Also, it's worth calling out that while the demo does not have full controller or Steam Deck support at this time, we plan to include those features in the full release later this year. Additionally, we’re working on localization across multiple languages—stay tuned for updates on player interface options, subtitles, and supported features coming at launch.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Join Other Dispatchers[/h3][p]We're incredibly fortunate to have such a welcoming and engaged community of Dispatchers on our Discord! If you’d like to connect with fellow players while waiting for launch, join the [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/adhocstudio"]official AdHoc Studio server[/url][/b]—where our development team actively chats with the community and shares exclusive updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343539/5d39fdc481b497b18036a83c5e33ce8be1b3b529.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Happy Dispatching! [/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Aaron Paul stars in Dispatch, a story based superhero management game from ex-Telltale devs
notes.notes:
Aaron Paul, he of a heartbreakingly fraught performance as Todd in Bojack Horseman, and also Breaking Bad, is starring in a new strategy story game from AdHoc, a studio with ex-Telltale developers at the helm. Dispatch is a story-focused strategy game where you’ll play a broke superhero trying to get himself a new mech suit by working at a hero dispatch center. Having trouble tracking a trailer down for this one, but you can find it here on Steam.
